description: This file defines the SuiteMozaik class, which manages a modular content template system with predefined layout thumbnails, dependencies, and HTML rendering functionalities for a web-based interface.

classes.name: SuiteMozaik
classes.description: A class providing methods to generate and manage HTML interfaces for a suite of template thumbnails and content editing tools, including dependencies, thumbnails, and content placeholders.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SuiteMozaik object, optionally populating default thumbnails and creating TemplateSectionLine beans.

methods.name: getContentLipsum
methods.description: Returns a string of placeholder Lorem Ipsum text.

methods.name: getContentImageSample
methods.description: Generates an HTML img tag with a sample image, optionally with a specified width.

methods.name: getDependenciesHTML
methods.description: Returns HTML script and link tags for including necessary JavaScript and CSS dependencies.

methods.name: getIncludeHTML
methods.description: Returns HTML tags to include CSS and JavaScript files specific to Mozaik.

methods.name: tinyMCESetupArgumentFixer
methods.description: Converts a TinyMCE setup configuration into a properly formatted JSON string, ensuring correct syntax.

methods.name: getElementHTML
methods.description: Generates HTML for a content editor component with embedded scripts to initialize mozaik settings.

methods.name: getAllHTML
methods.description: Combines dependencies, inclusion files, and the main element HTML into a complete content editing interface.

methods.name: getRefreshTextareaScript
methods.description: Returns JavaScript code to update a textarea with the current content from the Mozaik editor.

methods.name: getThumbs
methods.description: Retrieves thumbnail configurations from the database, cached per group.

methods.name: getThumbImageHTML
methods.description: Returns an HTML img element for a thumbnail image if it exists, otherwise returns the label.
